storyboardPrompt.fullPrompt: An eight-panel colour storyboard sheet from a feature animation studio's pre-production, arranged in two even rows of four panels on a warm off-white page. Each panel is a 16:9 landscape rectangle with a thin dark border, evenly spaced, with a small hand-written shot number in the corner of each panel. Painted digital storyboard art — soft loose brushwork, simplified appealing character shapes, minimal facial detail, strong atmospheric lighting and clear colour design in every panel. Rich saturated colour, warm and cinematic, in the style of a feature animation colour script. Not photorealistic, not flat vector, not line art. Panel 1 [shot 1]: Wide shot at eye level. Boy with light olive skin and black sunglasses pushed up on his forehead sitting on carpet, small boy with light olive skin sitting beside him watching. Daytime window key from left, warm soft shadows, muted beige browns with one saturated accent. Panel 2 [shot 2]: Medium shot at eye level. Teenage girl with light olive skin wearing a warm mustard hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair leaning forward, boy with light olive skin and black sunglasses pushed up on his forehead nodding. Daytime window key from left, warm soft shadows, muted living room tones with mustard accent. Panel 3 [shot 3]: Medium shot at eye level. Small boy with light olive skin holding cards out, boy with light olive skin and black sunglasses pushed up on his forehead clamping cards to chest. Bright daytime key from window, warm shadows, muted beige with green accent. Panel 4 [shot 4]: Medium shot at eye level. Teenage girl with light olive skin wearing a warm mustard hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair shuffling cards, boy with light olive skin and black sunglasses pushed up on his forehead bouncing on knees. Daytime window key from left, warm shadows, muted tones with mustard accent. Panel 5 [shot 5]: Medium shot at eye level. Adult woman with light olive skin wearing a deep teal hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair kneeling, boy with light olive skin and black sunglasses pushed up on his forehead looking up. Soft evening window light from right, warm gentle shadows, muted tones with teal accent. Panel 6 [shot 6]: Close-up at eye level. Boy with light olive skin and black sunglasses pushed up on his forehead looking up, adult woman with light olive skin wearing a deep teal hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair leaning in. Warm lamp key from front, soft shadows, muted tones with teal accent. Panel 7 [shot 7]: Medium shot at eye level. Adult woman with light olive skin wearing a deep teal hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair clapping, boy with light olive skin and black sunglasses pushed up on his forehead smiling. Warm window key from left, glowing soft shadows, muted warm tones with teal accent. Panel 8 [shot 8]: Wide shot at eye level. Boy with light olive skin and black sunglasses pushed up on his forehead sitting tall, adult woman with light olive skin wearing a deep teal hijab fully covering hair and hairline with no visible hair clapping. Soft daytime window light, warm lingering shadows, muted beige with teal accent. Cohesive colour design across the whole sheet. No text or writing in the panels other than the shot numbers. No watermark, no logos, no border around the page.
